betas.purpose: To estimate pure play betas by business, to use in estimating a bottom up beta for a project or a company.

definitions.Number of firms: Number of firms in the indusry grouping.
definitions.Beta: Simple average across firms of each firm's beta, taken as a weighted average of 2-year and 5-year weekly return regression betas, with 2-year betas weighted 2/3rds. If the company has only a 2-year beta, it is used.
definitions.D/E Ratio: Total debt, including lease debt/ Market Value of equity. I aggregate each number across the firms and then compute the aggregate debt to equity ratio.
definitions.Effective Tax Rate: Effective tax rate in the most recxent 12 months.
definitions.Unlevered Beta: Beta/ (1+ (1-tax rate) (D/E)). You can use either a marginal or effective tax rate as your option.
definitions.Cash/Firm Value: Cash & Marketable Securities/ (Market Value of Equity + Total Debt, including lease debt. Aggregated across companies first ans then computed.
definitions.Unlevered Beta corrected for cash: Unlevered Beta/ (1- Cash/Firm Vaue). Cash has a beta of zero. With this calculation, I remove its effect to get a pure play beta.
definitions.HiLo Risk: Simple average of (High Price for year - Low Price/ (High Price + Low Price). It is a non-parametric and simple measure of price risk.
definitions.Standard deviation (equity): Simple average across firms of each firm's standard deviation in stock prices in the prior 2 years, using weekly returns.
definitions.Standard deviation (operating income): Simple average across firms of each firm's coefficient of variation in annual operating income over prior 10 years. (Coefficient of variation is standard deviation divided by average operating income over the period)

wacc.purpose: To estimate the hurdle rate (required return) on both equity and overall capital invested for firms.

definitions.Number of firms: Number of firms in the indusry grouping.
definitions.Beta: Average regression beta across companies in the group.
definitions.Cost of Equity: Risk free Rate + Beta * Equity Risk Premium, in US $
definitions.D/(D+E): Total Debt (including lease debt)/ (Total Debt (including lease debt)+ Market Cap), aggregated across all firms in group, with all numbers other than market cap coming from most recent balance sheet; market cap is as of last day of the most recent year.
definitions.Cost of debt: Pre-tax cost of borrowing for sector, estimated based upon the standard deviation of equity.
definitions.After-tax Cost of Debt: Pre-tax cost of borrowing (1- Marginal tax rate), in US $
definitions.Cost of Capital: Cost of Equity * (Equity/ (Debt + Equity)) + Cost of Debt (1- Marginal tax rate) *(Debt/ (Debt + Equity)), with aggregated debt and market equity values across all companies in the sector, using most recent balance sheet for debt and most recent year-end for equity.
definitions.Cost of Capital (local currency): You can convert the $ cost of capital for a sector into any other currency, if you can estimate an expected inflation rate for the local currency.

definitions.Number of firms: Number of firms in the industry grouping.
definitions.Gross Margin: Aggregated gross profits as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.Net Margin: Aggregated net profits as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.Pre-tax, Pre-stock compensation Operatin: Aggregated operating profits, prior to taxes and stock compensation, as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.Pre-tax Unadjusted Operating Margin: Aggregated as-stated operating profits, prior to taxes, as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.After-tax Unadjusted Operating Margin: Aggregated as-stated operating profits, after netting effective taxes, as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.Pre-tax Lease adjusted Margin: Aggregated operating profits, adjusted for leases treated as debt, as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.After-tax Lease Adjusted Margin: Aggregated operating profits, adjusted for leases treated as debt and taxes, as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.

definitions.After-tax Lease & R&D adj Margin: Aggregated operating profits, adjusted for leases treated as debt and R&D as a capital expense, after effective taxes, as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.EBITDA/Sales: Aggregated EBITDA as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.EBITDASG&A/Sales: Aggregated EBITDA, with SG&A added back, as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.COGS/Sales: Aggregated cost of goods sold (COGS) as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.R&D/Sales: Aggregated R&D costs as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.SG&A/ Sales: Aggregated SG&A costs as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.Stock-Based Compensation/Sales: Aggregated stock-based compensation expensed, as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.Lease Expense/Sales: Aggregated current year's lease expense, as a percent of aggregated revenues, across companies in the group.
definitions.Lease adjustment to operating income: Operating Income + Current year's lease exp - Lease Asset Depreciation
definitions.R&D adjustment to operating income: Operating Income + Current year's R&D exp - Amortization of R&D asset

definitions.(ROC - Cost of Capital): ROC- Cost of Capital, averaged across the sector
definitions.BV of Capital: (Book Value of Equity + BV of Debt - Cash), aggregated across all firms in the group, in most recent balance sheet.
definitions.EVA: (ROC - Cost of Capital)* BV of Capital, defined as above, and aggregated across companies (in $ millions)

definitions.Number of firms: Number of firms in the indusry grouping.
definitions.Total Debt: I use all interest bearing debt, short term as well as long term, and add on the PV of lease commitments as debt. (See lease debt for details)
definitions.Capital (Market): Market capital = Total Debt (including lease debt), as of last balance sheet + Market capitalization (as of year end).
definitions.Capital (Book): Book Capital = Total Debt (including lease debt), as of last balance sheet + Book Value of Equity, as of last balance sheet
definitions.Market Debt to Capital: Total debt aggregated across all firms in group, based upon last balance sheet/ Market Capitalization, as of end of most recent year

definitions.Institutional Holdings: Simple average across all firms in group of percent of outstanding shares held by institutional investors, as of the most recent filings with institutional authorities.
definitions.Net PP&E/ Total Assets: Net property, plant and equipment, aggregated across all firms in group as reported on the most recent balance sheet.
definitions.EBITDA/EV: Aggregated EBITDA across firms in group, based upon TTM/ Aggregated Market Cap end of most recent year + Aggregated Total Debt in most recent balance sheet - Aggregated Cash & Marketable Securities in most recent balance sheet.
definitions.Standard deviation (equity): Simple average across firms of each firm's standard deviation in stock prices in the prior 2 years, using weekly returns.
definitions.Capital Spending/ Total Assets: Aggregated Capital Expenditures across firms in group, based upon TTM/ Aggregated Total Book value of Assets in most recent balance sheet

debtdetails.purpose: Details of debt held by firms (lease vs conventional, ST vs LT)

definitions.Number of firms: Number of firms in the indusry grouping.
definitions.Lease Debt (my estimate): Aggregated value of present value of lease commitments reported in financial statements, using the pre-tax cost of debt (my estimate) as the discount rate. (Lease commitments beyond year 5 converted into annual lease payments for extended period).
definitions.Conventional Debt: Aggregated value of all interest bearing debt, reported on balance sheet, including short term borrowings and long term borrowings.
definitions.Total Debt with leases: Sum of lease debt (my estimate) and conventional debt.
definitions.Interest Expense: Aggregated value of interest expenses of all firms in industry group, as reported in income statements.
definitions.Book Interest rate: Aggregated value of interest expenses/ Aggregated value of conventional (interest-bearing) debt.
definitions.Short term Debt as % of Total Debt: Aggregated Short term (<1 year) debt as percent of aggregated conventional (interest-bearning) debt.
definitions.Lease Debt (Accounting): Starting in 2019, IFRS and GAAP are requiring that lease commitments be reported as debt. Since the accounting rules for what should be counted as lease commitments and the discount rate used to get present value are different from mine, this number can be different from my estimate.

definitions.Dividends: Aggregated value (in $ millions) of dividends, regular & special, paid out by companies in group, in trailing 12 months.
definitions.Net Income: Aggregated value (in $ millions), across all companies in group, of net income in trailing 12 months.
definitions.Payout: (in $ millions) of dividends, regular & special, paid out by companies in group, in trailing 12 months/ Aggregated value (in $ millions) of net income in trailing 12 months.
definitions.Dividends + Buybacks: Aggregated value (in $ millions) of dividends, regular & special, paid out by companies in group, in trailing 12 months + Aggregated Stock Buybacks (in $ millions) by companies in group, in trailing 12 months
definitions.Cash Return: (Aggregated value (in $ millions) of dividends, regular & special, paid out by companies in group, in trailing 12 months + Aggregated Stock Buybacks (in $ millions) by companies in group, in trailing 12 months)/Aggregated value (in $ millions), across all companies in group, of net income in trailing 12 months.
definitions.Dividends + Buybacks, net of stock issua: Aggregated value (in $ millions) of dividends, regular & special, paid out by companies in group, in trailing 12 months + Aggregated Stock Buybacks (in $ millions) by companies in group, in trailing 12 months - Aggregated Stock Issuances (in $ millions) by companies in group, in trailing 12 months
definitions.FCFE, before debt cash flows: Aggregated Net Income + Aggregated Depreciation - Aggregated Cap ex (including R&D and acquisitons), across all firms in group, using trailing 12 month data.
definitions.FCFE, after debt cash flows: Aggregated Net Income + Aggregated Depreciation - Aggregated Cap ex (including R&D and acquisitons) + Aggregated New Debt raised - Aggregated Debt repaid, across all firms in group, using trailing 12 month data.
definitions.Net Cash Returns as % of FCFE: (Dividends + Buybacks - Net Stock Issuances)/ FCFE, all based upon aggregated values across all companies in group, based upon trailing 12 month data.
definitions.Net Cash Returns as % of Net Income: (Dividends + Buybacks - Net Stock Issuances)/ Net Income, all based upon aggregated values across all companies in group, based upon trailing 12 month data.
definitions.Cash/ Firm Value: Cash & Marketable Securities/ (Total Debt, includsing leases + Market Cap), all based upon aggregated values across all companies in group, based upon most recent balance sheet for all items but market cap, which is as of the end of the most recent year.
